name: Keepers' Dissension: Unchained
storyline: The game is set in the Seventh Realm, a vast and unfinished universe that was left without a Weaver to watch over it. The Keepers' Guild, co-founded by the dragon Archon and the inventor Beeborp, broke apart when Archon stood for restraint and Beeborp for forbidden mastery. In the dissension that followed, Keeper is set against Keeper. Four worlds field armies: the frozen world of Algar (Snow), the machine-merged world of Makkryz (Cyborg), the dragon-ruled world of Dwell (Dragon) and the forest world of Aldaia (Forest). Every match reenacts that struggle: a Keeper leads an army, a chained Guardian stands watch, and a Life Force must not fall.
summary: Keepers' Dissension: Unchained is a turn-based strategy board game for two players, played on a 7x7 battlefield. Each player commands a Keeper and an army of warriors from one of four factions (Snow, Cyborg, Forest and Dragon), managing a resource called Strange Matter to buy and use ability cards while defending their own Life Force and attacking the opponent's. Matches are played online against other players or against a bot, with private rooms, quick play, ranked ladders and live spectating.
